messages:
jess: heads up — we just saw slice-rebalancer kick a bunch of dedicated slices across r02 -> r05 and r08, and a few of those moves correlated with GPU thermal throttles + sharp egress bursts. apps hitting those tenants saw 5–10x tail latency for a minute.

sam: ack. did the rebalancer consider nic/egress pressure?

jess: looks like not — it prioritized slot balance only. alloc-bot posted these events around the same time: `ALLOC: slice-17 migrate r02->r05; slice-31 migrate r05->r08` (no egress hint).

mia: ugh. we've seen this pattern before — moving slices without egress/thermal awareness trips noisy-neighbor cascades. r05 has a known NIC burst history.

ana: (typo, meant ana) we should pause the in-flight migrations while we triage. options: 1) pause rebalancer for hot slices, 2) add a short cooling hysteresis to prefer non-burst racks, 3) throttle migration concurrency.

jess: I'm pausing rebalancer for the noisy cohort now: `rb-control --pause-slice slice-17 --reason "thermal-thrash"` — done.

alloc-bot: NOTICE: rebalancer paused for slices [slice-17, slice-31] by jess.

sam: can we also apply a temporary soft-affinity for tenants flagged as latency-sensitive? that would avoid moving them into racks with bad recent egress patterns.

mia: yes — we can surface `egress_score` and `thermal_score` to the scheduler and shift weighting. quick hack: reduce move score by 1000 if `egress_rate > 800Mbps` or `gpu_temp_avg > 78C` in last 10m.

lee: cost question: if we introduce additional anti-migration heuristics, we might increase steady-state imbalance and reserved GPU underutilization — product will ask for the delta. we should measure the cost of tail-latency incidents vs utilization loss.

ana (ana): agree — propose a short perf experiment: 24h with hysteresis enabled in eu-west canary (10% slices) and compare p99 latency, egress spikes, and GPU utilization. I'll own metrics.

jess: sounds good. immediate mitigations we did: paused affected migrations, added temporary NIC throttle rule on r05 for tenant egress bursts, and triggered a heatmap snapshot.

sam: any quick config we can flip if it flares up during peak? a single toggle would be ideal.

mia: `rb-config set migration_concurrency=2; rb-config set prefer_low_egress=true` — those are safe toggles. I'll prepare a one-liner patch and put it behind a deploy toggle.

lee: please also add a short note for sales/customer-success: tenants with Dedicated slices might see planned anti-migration behavior to prioritize latency. they'd likely ask.

jess: adding to #customer-success notify doc now.

ana (ana): experiment doc: https://goto/internal/infra/experiments/slice-hysteresis-euw — check it after I push metrics.

sam: thanks — followup checklist: 1) run canary 24h, 2) compare p99 & egress tail, 3) estimate utilization loss, 4) propose SLA-friendly defaults.

jess: assigned. i'll update thread after 24h. :thumbsup:

lee: ping me if we need a cost deck for execs.

mia: one more note — long term we should enrich the rebalancer with a short-term KV cache awareness (prefetched KV hotness) so we avoid moving slices that will cause cold cache storm. filing ticket after triage.

jess: thanks everyone. that's the plan.
